name: Borrowing Money
overview: Scripture instructs believers to act justly and compassionately when lending money, especially to those in need, forbidding the charging of interest to the poor as seen in Exodus 22:25 and Deuteronomy 15:7. God's blessing is promised to those who live righteously, enabling them to lend rather than borrow, as highlighted in Deuteronomy 28:12. Furthermore, the Bible contrasts the wicked who borrow without repaying with the righteous who show mercy and generosity (Psalms 37:21), encouraging diligence and wise stewardship exemplified by the ant in Proverbs 6:6.
